_comment: Default Quick Voice Bridge task registry for Chief of Staff (Jarvis). Point Amazon Quick's scheduled 'voice-bridge-watcher' agent at your COS_BRIDGE_ROOT (default ~/Documents/CoS-Bridge); Quick reads requests/ and CREATES responses/ + outputs/. Chief Growth Officer (growth-summary), Marketing & Sales, Bookings, and Family/Kids updates are intentionally excluded from this build.

daily-summary.description: Daily activity + work email briefing for the past 24 hours.

finance-summary.description: CFO briefing built from the customer's financial report emails (e.g. AWS Cost Report). Spend, trends, service + LLM breakdown.

email-check.description: Scans unread inbox emails from the past 24 hours and flags urgent items.

calendar-check.description: Today's events from your calendar, chronologically.

system-status.description: Health of scheduled agents from the activity feed.
